title: EGCG (Epigallocatechin Gallate) Health Benefits Backed by Science
abstract:
EGCG (epigallocatechin gallate) is a plant compound found mainly in green tea. Research suggests it may improve mood, cognition, weight management, and more.
Kochman J, Jakubczyk K, Antoniewicz J, Mruk H, Janda K. Health Benefits and Chemical Composition of Matcha Green Tea: A Review. Molecules. 2020;26(1):85. Published 2020 Dec 27. doi:10.3390/molecules26010085 · Kapoor MP, Sugita M, Fukuzawa Y, Okubo T. Physiological effects of epigallocatechin-3-gallate (EGCG) on energy expenditure for prospective fat oxidation in humans: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
Vázquez Cisneros LC, López-Uriarte P, López-Espinoza A, et al. [Effects of green tea and its epigallocatechin (EGCG) content on body weight and fat mass in humans: a systematic review]. Nutr Hosp. 2017;34(3):731-737.
Animal research found a neuroprotective (brain-protecting) and anti-inflammatory effect of EGCG. However, human studies have not observed similar results.
